# The Art Spa Tulum

> Gallery-inspired day spa in La Veleta, Tulum, Quintana Roo, Mexico. Massages, couples rituals, Mayan treatments, facials, private sauna and cold hydropool, surrounded by original photography, paintings and wall art by artists. Prices in MXN. Bilingual (English/Spanish).

## Key facts
- Address: Supermanzana 15, Manzana 69, La Veleta, 77760 Tulum, Quintana Roo, Mexico
- Coordinates: 20.1964909, -87.4657934
- Hours: Open every day, 10:00–19:00 (America/Cancun)
- WhatsApp / phone: +52 984 100 7119
- Email: theartspatulum@gmail.com
- Online booking: https://www.theartspatulum.mx/book/ (instant confirmation via SimplyBook.me)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/theartspatulum/
- Facilities: private hot sauna, cold hydropool, massage rooms incl. couples suite, art gallery interior
- Price range: $450–$5,800 MXN. Massages from $1,250 MXN (60 min). Couples packages from $2,599 MXN for two.
- Neighborhood: La Veleta, a few minutes from downtown Tulum and the Hotel Zone road

## Signature Specials
- [The Reset Ritual](https://www.theartspatulum.mx/treatments/reset-ritual/): 90 min, $1,249 MXN (per person). A private body reset that releases tension, slows the mind and leaves you lighter: a 60-minute organic coconut aromatherapy massage followed by 30 minutes of hot sauna and pool time.
- [The Glow Ritual](https://www.theartspatulum.mx/treatments/glow-ritual/): 75 min, $1,400 MXN (per person). A hydrating facial ritual that replenishes moisture and revives your natural glow, opened with a pore-opening sauna session.
- [The Couple Ritual](https://www.theartspatulum.mx/treatments/couple-ritual/): 90 min, $2,599 MXN (for two people). A private experience for two: side-by-side organic coconut aromatherapy massage, then sauna and pool time together. Our best-value couples massage in Tulum.
- [Sauna & Face Mask Ritual](https://www.theartspatulum.mx/treatments/sauna-face-mask-ritual/): 60 min, $450 MXN (per person). Sauna warmth, a refreshing dip in the pool, a Korean facial mask of your choice and a cup of tea, all in your own private space.
- [Lymphatic Drainage Massage](https://www.theartspatulum.mx/treatments/lymphatic-drainage-massage/): 60 min, $1,800 MXN. Gentle, rhythmic movements stimulate lymphatic circulation to reduce fluid retention and leave the body lighter and refreshed.

## Facials
- [Basil Glow Facial](https://www.theartspatulum.mx/treatments/basil-glow-facial/): 60 min, $1,199 MXN. A gentle lifting facial that improves tone, firmness and radiance without harsh techniques. You leave rested, lifted and brighter.
- [Detox Charcoal Facial](https://www.theartspatulum.mx/treatments/charcoal-detox-facial/): 60 min, $1,199 MXN. A deep-cleansing facial without mechanical extractions. Activated charcoal clears impurities, excess oil and congested pores.
- [24K Gold Anti-Aging Facial](https://www.theartspatulum.mx/treatments/24k-gold-facial/): 60 min, $1,199 MXN. A lifting, anti-aging facial infused with 24K gold to improve elasticity, smooth fine lines and restore a radiant glow.
- [Collagen Hydration Facial](https://www.theartspatulum.mx/treatments/collagen-hydration-facial/): 60 min, $1,199 MXN. A gelatin facial mask with hyaluronic acid and seaweed that deeply hydrates, purifies pores and revitalizes. Suitable for sensitive skin.
- [Egyptian Rose Facial](https://www.theartspatulum.mx/treatments/egyptian-rose-facial/): 60 min, $1,199 MXN. A balancing, soothing facial with rose blossom oil, collagen and ginseng that calms irritated skin and evens tone.
- [Ear Candling Therapy](https://www.theartspatulum.mx/treatments/ear-candling/): 30 min, $700 MXN. A gentle, non-invasive traditional ritual enjoyed for rest and balance. No heat is felt in the ear canal. A lovely add-on to a self-care day.

## Sauna & Hydropool
- [Sauna & Face Mask Ritual](https://www.theartspatulum.mx/treatments/sauna-face-mask-ritual/): 60 min, $450 MXN (per person). Sauna warmth, a refreshing dip in the pool, a Korean facial mask of your choice and a cup of tea, all in your own private space.
- [Sauna & Whirlpool](https://www.theartspatulum.mx/treatments/sauna-whirlpool/): 60 min, $600 MXN (per person · group discounts available). Hot sauna and a cold, bubbling hydropool (cold pool) for contrast therapy, plus towel, water and hot tea.

## FAQ
- Q: Where is The Art Spa Tulum? A: We are in La Veleta, Tulum, at Supermanzana 15, Manzana 69, 77760 Tulum, Quintana Roo, Mexico. La Veleta is a few minutes from downtown Tulum and on the way to the Hotel Zone.
- Q: What are your opening hours? A: We are open every day, Monday to Sunday, from 10:00 to 19:00 (Tulum time).
- Q: How do I book a massage or facial? A: Book online 24/7 on our Book page and choose your treatment, date and time; you'll get instant confirmation. You can also message us on WhatsApp at +52 984 100 7119.
- Q: How much does a massage cost in Tulum at The Art Spa? A: Massages start at $1,250 MXN for a 60-minute aromatherapy massage. Our Reset Ritual (massage + sauna + pool, 90 min) is $1,249 MXN, and couples massage packages start at $2,599 MXN for two people.
- Q: Do you offer couples massage? A: Yes. We have a private room for couples and several couples rituals, from The Couple Ritual ($2,599 MXN for two, 90 min) to two-hour rituals with sauna, scrubs, wraps and massage.
- Q: Do you have a sauna and hydropool? A: Yes. We have a private hot sauna and a cold hydropool. You can book Sauna & Whirlpool on its own ($600 MXN per person, 60 min), and most rituals include sauna time.
- Q: What makes The Art Spa different? A: We are a gallery-inspired spa: original photography, paintings and wall art by artists line the space, so your treatment happens surrounded by art. It is designed to encourage creativity, presence and pause.
- Q: How far in advance should I book? A: Same-day bookings are often available. Couples and body rituals must be reserved at least 1–2 hours before the start time so we can prepare the products.
- Q: What currency are your prices in? A: All prices are in Mexican pesos (MXN).
- Q: Do you offer group bookings? A: Yes. Contact us on WhatsApp for group bookings and group discounts on sauna and treatments.
